quotes.text: the land was changed because of the tempest, and the whirlwinds, and the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the exceeding great quaking of the whole earth ; and the highways were broken up, and the level roads were spoiled, and many smooth places became rough, and many great and notable cities were sunk, and many were burned, and many were shook till the buildings thereof had fallen to the…
With his strong hand he stayed the powers of darkness — he provided a path f r our feet, and led us forth from the gales of death!
